test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

​

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5683d4b2bf6b2c12905603b9cb8554dad0bdfb22d2857e4547d8374a11a97886.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster follows the pattern +2, -7.

1. FHA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f83bf51dc8916ab2016f731d55e6f2c9b6047a668497af51e3ab5d7d2cba5b19.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +2, -7.

2. SUN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/274200aa077f88a456daa644d1e37f2e7672f09d071ae618f5cacea6ceb66e7f.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +2, -7.

3. PRK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8266c59b32efc949bca8b31ad81e1a6a54eef3b1aa44db679831f5b90ab1d3.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +2, -7.

4. KME

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3d7df7ff63308fce23aced069a68e2e2be583259f5be3fb6f2b0a3638b9196a.png] 

This letter-cluster does not follow the pattern +2, -7.

Thus, KME is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**"
